claims.text: Full Fact rated this “This isn’t what happened. There are no plans for the Speaker to meet the head of the Palestinian mission and he did not announce any such meeting in the House of Commons. This claim is based on an email which the Speaker’s office has confirmed was “sent in error”.”
claims.note: CLAIM REVIEWED (not ours, and not about our data): “The Speaker of the House of Commons announced that the Palestinian flag was to be flown for a visit from the Palestinian ambassador.” Reviewed by Full Fact (fullfact.org). Their rating, in their words: “This isn’t what happened. There are no plans for the Speaker to meet the head of the Palestinian mission and he did not announce any such meeting in the House of Commons. This claim is based on an email which the Speaker’s office has confirmed was “sent in error”.”. MATCHED BY NAME: this review was found by searching fact-checkers' databases for “Sir Lindsay Hoyle”, not by any identifier. Names are shared, so it may concern a different person of the same name - read the article before relying on it. Read it: https://fullfact.org/online/speaker-palestinian-ambassador-meeting/
